title: hypothesis type mixin
$comment: The first PROJECT-authored kind on the shared schema system. Every disposition below traces to docs/plans/2026-07-12-hypothesis-field-adjudication.md; test_mixin_hypothesis.py is that adjudication in executable form. Composed against science-entity-base/2.0 (base 1.0 enum-locks `kind` to the four commons kinds, and an allOf can only narrow).

id.$comment: PREFIX only — base 2.0 owns the id's shape (it is kind-agnostic by design), and the mixin owns its identity. Without this, base 2.0's generic pattern happily admits `id: dataset:foo` on a hypothesis: the `kind` const would pass and the id would name a different entity. Deliberately NOT a full slug pattern — inventing one would hard-fail whichever of the 147 real ids I did not think of.

status.description: LIFECYCLE. Not the verdict. Sourced from the old `phase` field (design rev 7).

verdict.description: EPISTEMIC. What the evidence concludes. ABSENT = not yet assessed — which is why `proposed`/`under-investigation` are NOT admitted: they would be a third spelling of absence.

closure_basis.description: The AUTHORED reason a terminal entity closed, required when no structural basis exists. The state is derivable; the reason is not.
closure_basis.$comment: `\S`, NOT `minLength: 1` — a single space has length 1. `closure_basis: " "` satisfied the `retired` conditional and closed the entity with a reason that says nothing, which is the fail-open this field exists to prevent.

resynthesized_into.$comment: A LIST — see archive.py:38 and materialize.py:155. `minItems: 1` because the terminal conditionals key off PRESENCE: `resynthesized_into: []` is present, so it discharged `superseded` while naming no successor at all — and the cross-record resolver (Task 7) would then find no reference to dangle and report nothing. An empty basis is not a basis.

profile.$comment: AUTHORED and honored — sources.py:765-772 is fill-if-missing, materialize.py:640 emits sci:profile, entities_inventory.py:195-199 derives registration_state from it. 3 files author it. An earlier draft called it derived and stripped it; that was wrong.

relations.$comment: LEG 1 of the D4 supersedable gate. The CANONICAL supersession edge is a `relations:` entry with `predicate: sci:supersedes` (consolidation.py:7-12) — NOT top-level `supersedes:`, which is silently dropped (fb-2026-07-11-017). With `unevaluatedProperties: false` and no declaration here, the ONLY carrier the toolkit reads was rejected outright, making `superseded` a terminal status this kind could not reach through any supported path.

composition_rule.$comment: The IMPLEMENTED rules (WEAKEST_LINK_COMPOSITION_RULES), NOT all of CompositionRule. `evidence_union` and `faceted_support` are RESERVED — declared in Python so the names are stable, and rejected at load by Entity._validate_composition_rule (entities.py:494). Enumerating all four here would admit two values the model refuses: an authored `evidence_union` would pass schema validation and then crash the loader, which is the schema pointing at the wrong file.

required_capabilities.$comment: 38 files, 3 projects. P1 subsystem — DECLARED, not yet absorbed. Reaches its readers through a raw-frontmatter re-parse today; undeclared, strictness hard-fails all 38. NO `minItems`: `[]` is `missing` to _capability_shape_issue, which is a WARN — the schema must not promote it to a hard failure.

capability_scope.$comment: Mirrors CAPABILITY_SCOPE_VALUES (datasets/capability_scope.py). Reconciled against it in Task 8, so a scope added in Python without regenerating this enum fails the suite.

allOf.$comment: RULED (rev 6): you cannot conclude without concluding something. `closure_basis` does NOT discharge this — admitting `complete` + absent-verdict would give `retired + closure_basis` a second spelling that reads, to every consumer, as though the hypothesis had been resolved.
`retired` is the only terminal with no structural basis available to it, so it ALWAYS requires an authored one. This is the fb-005 no-hidden-debt guarantee.
PRESENCE only. Whether the lineage RESOLVES is a cross-record fact and belongs to resolution.py — the schema cannot see other files.

`archived` requires an AUTHORED basis, exactly like `retired`. An earlier draft also admitted `archive_ref` as a structural discharge — a field with no reader anywhere in the toolkit, no author in the corpus, and NO RESOLVABLE NAMESPACE: the archive index (archive.py) is keyed by the archived entity's OWN id and mints no record identifier, so `archive_ref` could only ever have restated a fact derivable from `id`. A second, unversioned spelling of a derivable fact is the exact collapse this arc exists to undo, so it is gone.

authored_relation.$comment: AuthoredTargetedRelation (source_contracts.py) — predicate/target/graph_layer, and nothing else. `additionalProperties: false` because a typo'd key INSIDE a relation is silently dropped today, which is the class of defect this arc exists to end. `graph_layer` defaults to `graph/knowledge` in the model; it is optional here, and never required.

origin_record.$comment: OriginRecord (entities.py:241) — extra=forbid, so `additionalProperties: false` is the FAITHFUL translation, not added strictness.

allOf.$comment: OriginRecord._validate: a literature origin without a resolvable ref is an unfalsifiable provenance claim. The schema CAN express this one, so it does.

lens_view.$comment: LensView (entities.py:273) — extra=forbid. The `lens` enum MIRRORS science_model.lenses.LENS_SLUGS; test_the_lens_vocabulary_is_not_a_SECOND_authority (Task 8) fails the moment a lens is added without regenerating it.

review_state.$comment: EpistemicReviewState (entities.py:138). `review_horizon_days` must be POSITIVE. `additionalProperties: false` is STRICTER than the model (extra=ignore) — deliberately: a typo'd key inside `review_state` is silently dropped today, which is the exact class of defect this arc exists to end.

rival_model_packet.$comment: RivalModelPacket (reasoning.py:189) — CLOSED, and extended with the SINGLE-RIVAL form the corpus actually authors. The same four fields land on the MODEL in this task's Step 3c, with `exclude_if` so existing packets do not churn. Schema and model move together, in one commit, or protein-landscape/0001 fails validation in the gap.

packet_id.$comment: `\S`, NOT `minLength: 1` — a single space has length 1, so `packet_id: " "` would satisfy the packet's one required field while naming nothing. Same correction as `closure_basis`; this instance was missed when that one was fixed.

alternative_models.$comment: The LIST form. Declared by the model; authored by ZERO files.

capability_map.$comment: _capability_shape_issue (validate/checks/dataset_capabilities.py:197): a non-empty mapping of non-empty string keys to non-empty string values.
